newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary APV to sell more Richter shares.
newsitem.headline: Hungary APV to sell more Richter shares.

text.p: Hungarian privatisation agency APV will offer further shares from its stake in pharmaceutical company Richter in April, the APV said on Wednesday.
APV general director Pal Szabo told Hungarian economic news agency MTI-Econews the same advisors will manage the issue as did the last time round but did not divulge any further details.
The adviser to Richter's first two stages of privatisation was Creditanstalt Securities.
Shares were sold in a closed offering to international investors in October 1994 and in a public offering to Hungarian investors the following month.
This was followed by a further closed offering to international financial investors in November 1995.
APV currently owns 43.63 percent of Richter, while foreign investors own 44.11 percent.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Richter closed on Wednesday at 12,450 forints, up 555.
